name: @aicgen/aicgen
description: AI Config Generator - Automated AI assistant configuration for your projects
author: Lahiru Sandaruwan <lpsandaruwan@gmail.com>

scripts.embed: bun run generate-version && bun run scripts/embed-data.ts
scripts.build:binary: bun run embed && bun run scripts/build-binary.ts current
scripts.build:binary:windows: bun run embed && bun run scripts/build-binary.ts windows
scripts.build:binary:linux: bun run embed && bun run scripts/build-binary.ts linux
scripts.build:binary:macos: bun run embed && bun run scripts/build-binary.ts macos
scripts.build:binary:macos-x64: bun run embed && bun run scripts/build-binary.ts macos-x64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:binary:windows && bun run build:binary:linux && bun run build:binary:macos && bun run build:binary:macos-x64
